decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's core cheese range and was given its own page in 2019, so the firm is invested in it and sees little reason to drop it despite the missing recent evidence.
As a multi-variant spicy cheese line with its own page in 2019, it represents substantial sunk investment and visible commitment, so management would persist with it.
The firm publicly announced the mild soft cheese as rounding off its new range and gave it a dedicated page, so dropping it would mean reversing a visible commitment.
